basic_profile.bio: An experienced digital artist and motion designer, I've been tinkering with After Effects and other creative tools for over a decade. Living in the bustling city of San Francisco, I split my time between freelance projects and personal creative endeavors. I'm passionate about visual effects, high-speed trains, and the technicalities of rendering in Octane. Typically online during the late evenings, balancing work with leisure, I am single and enjoy exploring virtual reality experiences on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in digital media and self-taught expertise in motion graphics, I turned my passion into a career in freelance visual effects. My skills have been honed through countless hours of experimentation and online tutorials, particularly in After Effects and 3D rendering.
